{{Top}}
A '''standard week''', also known simply as a '''week''', was a [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] period of [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]. In some calendars, it consisted of 5 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> while the typical standard week consisted of 7 days.<ref name="Holonet">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]] and its articles, combined with the dates provided in the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', redefine the calendar system to have seven days in a week, as well as twelve months.</ref>

==Days of the week==
# [[Primeday/Legends|Primeday]]<ref name="Dining">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
# [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Taungsday/Legends|Taungsday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhellday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Benduday/Legends|Benduday]]<ref name="Dining" />

Some locales had other names for days of the week, including [[Thursday/Legends|Thursday]]<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> and [[Saturday/Legends|Saturday]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
